correctness.rationale: For W_n=K1 vee C_n, a hub-containing initial set forces exactly when its rim trace contains an adjacent pair: a blue boundary rim vertex can then extend a run; a rim independent trace has no possible first force. Hub-free connected sets are either a rim arc or the full rim and force exactly when their size is at least 3, since an interior blue rim vertex first forces the hub. Counting hub cases subtracts the cycle independence polynomial from (1+x)^n; rim-only runs add n x^j for 3<=j<=n-1 and x^n. Marked cyclic gaps prove i_{n,k}=n/(n-k)*binom(n-k,k). Independently simulated every subset for n=4,...,10, matching all coefficients and z_c(W_n;3)=2n.
risk: Finite enumeration checks only 4<=n<=10; the analytic cycle/hub case split is essential for all n>=4.
